sql: SELECT series, MAX("date") d, MIN("date") mn, COUNT(*) n FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series IN ('MORTGAGE30US','MSPUS','CPIAUCSL') GROUP BY series
SELECT "date", "value" FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='MORTGAGE30US' AND "date">='2026-08-01' ORDER BY "date"
SELECT "date", "value" FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='MORTGAGE30US' AND "date"<'1982-01-01' ORDER BY "value" DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT "year", median_income_current_dollars FROM census.household_income_history_national WHERE "year" IN (1980,1981,1982,1983,1984,1985,2019,2022,2023,2024) ORDER BY "year"
SELECT "date", "value" FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='MSPUS' AND ("date" LIKE '1980%' OR "date" LIKE '1981%' OR "date" LIKE '1982%' OR "date">='2023-01-01') ORDER BY "date"

SELECT SUBSTR("date",1,4) y, AVG("value") cpi FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='CPIAUCSL' AND (SUBSTR("date",1,4) IN ('1979','1980','1981') OR "date" IN ('2025-10-01','2026-10-01','2026-09-01')) GROUP BY SUBSTR("date",1,4), "date" ORDER BY y

SELECT CASE WHEN "date"<'1990-01-01' THEN '1980s' ELSE 'recent' END p, AVG("value") v, COUNT(*) n FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='MSPUS' AND (("date">='1980-01-01' AND "date"<'1990-01-01') OR "date">='2025-10-01') GROUP BY CASE WHEN "date"<'1990-01-01' THEN '1980s' ELSE 'recent' END
SELECT "date","value" FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='CPIAUCSL' AND "date" IN ('2025-09-01','2025-11-01','2025-12-01','2026-09-01','2026-10-01','2026-08-01','2025-08-01') ORDER BY "date"

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN "year" BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 THEN median_income_current_dollars END) inc80s, AVG(CASE WHEN "year" BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 THEN median_income_current_dollars END) x FROM census.household_income_history_national
SELECT SUBSTR("date",1,4) y, AVG("value") v FROM econ.fred_indicators WHERE series='MSPUS' AND SUBSTR("date",1,4) IN ('2019','2025') GROUP BY SUBSTR("date",1,4) ORDER BY y
SELECT "year", median_income_current_dollars FROM census.household_income_history_national WHERE "year" IN (2025)
